notes: Printed names: OHIO AV., CONKLIN (NOT OPEN), CLIFF (NOT OPEN), VAN LEAR (NOT OPEN), BAUER, VINE, PARKER, LIDDELL PL., GRAY TERRACE, GRAHAM, ELYISIAN (spelled so on the sheet; probably Elysian); suffix-less names written with 'Street', LIDDELL PL. as 'Liddell Place', GRAY TERRACE as printed. Conklin runs from Ohio east to Cliff (T both ends); the Conklin/Ohio junction is also on sheet 242 (recorded there too). Parker comes in from the west (242) and ends at Ohio (also on 242). Liddell Place (40') runs from Ohio east to Gray Terrace (T); Gray Terrace is a closed court (lines across both ends) with Liddell as its only outlet. Graham (50') runs from Ohio east to Cliff (T both ends); Elysian (50') leaves Graham to the south onto 232. Cliff (25' at the top, 50' from y~5360 south, unnamed on its 50' part) runs from 243 down past Conklin and Graham onto 232. Van Lear (30') comes down from 243 and ends at a lot line at y~3575; Bauer (30') runs from Van Lear east to Vine (T both ends; the hatched strip just north of Bauer between Cliff and Van Lear, y~1990-2150, looks like steps and is not recorded). Vine's east side is the Volume 2 area ('SEE VOLUME TWO'). Ohio's centre is taken midway between its two water pipes, which matches its block lines (~50 ft). The unnamed 15' alley at the top right (Vine at y~370) is the alley from Van Lear to Vine recorded on sheet 243; not repeated. A 25 ft strip between lot lines running east from Cliff at y~5030-5185 (a building stands in it) and the PRIVATE ROAD west of Ohio at y~5100 are not recorded as streets. The left strip (x < ~1900 above Parker) overlaps sheet 242.
